notes.title: Version 1.2.9 Adds Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese Support!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10847188/33aa31422e842f64221cfbf6a6adab24212b820b.png[/img]
Version 1.2.9 for Sora is now live, adding support two new languages - [b]Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese[/b]!

[i]We hope that with this update, even more players can experience the wonderful story of Sora.[/i]

Sora is also [b]-50% off this week[/b] in the Fruitbat Factory publisher sale!

notes.title: Version 1.2.8 Now Live!
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.2.8. Now Live![/b]
[list][*]Replays will now play in the language they were recorded with.
For versions older than 1.2.7, English language is used.
For version 1.2.7, please view replay in the language it was recorded in to ensure correct playback.
[*]Fixed a crash when launching the game without Steam active.[/list]

notes.title: New Languages, Steam Deck Support Added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10847188/e483e99274dfeaca2aea7bcb85e12a1c6e10c362.jpg[/img]
Rejoice! Based on community requests, Sora now has support for Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, and Korean as well! 

Moreover, full support has been added for Steam Input and Steam Deck!

[h3]Full Version 1.2.7. Patch Notes[/h3]
[list][*]Added language support for Japanese, Chinese (standard, traditional), and Korean languages.
[*]Added Steam Input and Steam Deck support.
[*]Opening video now uses the volume of Music Volume setting.
[*]Voiced lines now use the volume of Sound Effect Volume setting.
[*]Removed launcher (all settings can now be accessed in-game instead).[/list]

notes.title: Announcing an Orange Juice Board Game!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.level99store.com/pages/bullet-orange][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/1007b09870ce021e360b0314d1f3a2b72cb259cf.png[/img][/url]
Ever found yourself hoping for an Orange Juice-themed physical board game? Your wish has been heard!

We're most excited to announce a collaboration with [b]Level 99 Games[/b] to bring you [b]Bullet🍊[/b], an expansion to the fast-paced 1-4 player bullet hell-themed [b]Bullet♥︎[/b], featuring [b]Suguri, Sora, QP and Marc[/b] as new heroines!

[b]Bullet🍊[/b] is [url=https://www.level99store.com/pages/bullet-orange]now available for pre-order[/url], and all pre-orders will give you a bonus [b]Acceleration of SUGURI 2 Steam key[/b] as well!

Do note that this expansion requires [b]Bullet♥︎[/b] to play (sold separately).

You can also try the game and new expansion in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2100600905]official Tabletop Simulator version[/url] to get a feel for it!

notes.title: Sora Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://fruitbatfactory.files.wordpress.com/2016/01/tish-dance-tv.gif[/img]
Orange Juice's shooter [b]Sora[/b] is now available on Steam!

Sora tells the story of its namesake: the lone enhanced human, Sora, and her struggle to protect a fading world. Enjoy breathtakingly fast-paced combat in the Suguri universe, with improved game system and graphics along with original trance music by DEKU.

[list][b]Key Features[/b]:
[*]Fast-paced, tactical bullet hell action
[*]Three game modes: Story, Arcade and Match Mode
[*]Over 20 different weapons to unlock
[*]Bring three weapons to your missions
[*]English localization features new high resolution graphics[/list]

notes.title: Commencing the Operation in 100% Orange Juice
notes.content:
[img]https://fruitbatfactory.files.wordpress.com/2016/01/soramilitary.png[/img]
[b]Sora (Military)[/b] is now available to play in [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/282800]100% Orange Juice[/url] as a free bonus character for those who own [b]Sora[/b] on Steam! She's a rendition of Sora as she begins her journey in the game, dressed in her military uniform. 

Sora (Military) is equipped with a new hyper, [b]Awakening of Talent[/b], and a passive ability that keeps throwing her back into the heat of battle.

notes.title: Sora to Commence Her Operation on January 5th with a Bonus Character
notes.content:
[img]https://fruitbatfactory.files.wordpress.com/2015/12/sora_unlock.png[/img]
We are most happy to announce that a special bonus is coming for Sora, when it launches on [b]January 5th[/b]!

All owners of Sora on Steam will unlock a free bonus character in [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/282800]100% Orange Juice[/url]!

Sora (Military) is an original character designed by Orange Juice, drawn by Hono. She's a version of Sora from the days before her current appearance in 100% Orange Juice. Driven to fight in an endless war without a break, you can expect her playstyle to be wilder, with new abilities and a new hyper card, "Awakening of Talent".

The new character is prepared in cooperation with Orange Juice exclusively for the Steam release of Sora.

Sora is available for preorder from the official Fruitbat Factory store.
